recent_excerpts: Bitdefender found Midnight Mimosa ad-fraud malware preinstalled on thousands of MediaTek-based Android phones across 150+ countries, with 32 disguised payload apps.
Google's September Pixel bulletin patches CVE-2026-58704, a high-severity modem privilege-escalation flaw under limited, targeted exploitation, plus 109 other bugs.
Three men arrested in Toronto for operating an SMS blaster that impersonated cell towers to send phishing texts targeting banking credentials in a multi-month campaign.
